name: com.streethawk.library.geofence.SHCoreModuleReceiver
description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. StreetHawk starts this receiver for server app-status messages, location-provider changes, and scheduled location checks. It refreshes the configured geofence list, restarts monitoring when settings change, and reports when location is disabled.
disableEffect: StreetHawk geofence settings and background monitoring will no longer refresh or respond to location changes.
